population.span: Investigator-initiated, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized clinical trial among 360 consecutive candidates for cardiac surgery enrolled in 11 Italian centers between March 2012 and March 2014.

endpoint.span: main secondary study end points were postoperative AF and pericardial or pleural effusion.

estimate.span: postoperative AF (colchicine, 61 patients [33.9%]; placebo, 75 patients [41.7%]; absolute difference, 7.8%; 95% CI, -2.2% to 17.6%)

ci.span: postoperative AF (colchicine, 61 patients [33.9%]; placebo, 75 patients [41.7%]; absolute difference, 7.8%; 95% CI, -2.2% to 17.6%)

treatment_strategy.span: Patients were randomized to receive placebo (n=180) or colchicine (0.5 mg twice daily in patients \u226570 kg or 0.5 mg once daily in patients <70 kg; n=180) starting between 48 and 72 hours before surgery and continued for 1 month after surgery.

follow_up.span: PROTOCOL PRIMARY OUTCOME: Post-pericardiotomy syndrome, post-operative effusions, post-operative atrial fibrillation incidence | Incidence of the outcomes at 3 months from cardiac surgery | TIME FRAME: 3 months

absent_reason.analysis_set: The sources do not explicitly identify the analysis population for the 61 versus 75 postoperative AF events. The explicitly named on-treatment analysis reports different counts.

served_mismatch: The served arm-level event counts agree with the abstract. However, the source reports an absolute difference and its CI, not an RR or RR CI. The served intention-to-treat label is not explicitly established by the held sources. The served in-hospital / index-admission timepoint is not supported: the registry specifies outcome incidence at 3 months.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Registry eligibility specifies adults who are candidates for cardiac surgery, excluding cardiac transplantation; the estimate's intention-to-treat status remains unstated.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Inclusion Criteria: * Age \> 18years * Candidate to cardiac surgery but cardiac transplantation * Informed consent

notes: Registry spans establish adult eligibility and the protocol follow-up window; the abstract does not explicitly link its AF estimate to that window. Denominators are randomized arm sizes from the intervention span. The reported absolute difference is positive in the placebo-minus-colchicine direction. No RR or RR CI was calculated. BOUND applies to the reported AF counts and absolute difference with its CI.
